_comment: IRF extraction (blind, reference dye, scatter, photons outside the bursts), drawn by emtk.view_form over the app's form adapter (gui/app.py _Form: the IRFViewModel's fields, the app's actions). The toolbar (Save IRF, Transfer to ChiSurf, data label, Guide, ?), the parameter group, the Estimate button and the status bar, in that order. The custom sections input (the workspace Input section) and status are drawn by callbacks registered in app.py (FormState.custom); the plot and the results are their own dock windows.

sections.description: The loaded file or dataset, or why loading failed.
The decay to estimate the IRF from, picked from the Datasets workspace (files dropped on the ChiSurf window are listed there).
Where the IRF comes from, and the settings of its extraction.

sections.label: Source
sections.description: What the loaded decay is, and so how the IRF is taken from it. Blind: a fluorescence decay; its tail is fitted with a truncated exponential and deconvolved (Richardson-Lucy). Reference dye: a dye of one known lifetime (Rh110, Alexa647); its polarised exponential is deconvolved, the lifetime fitted to its tail, the rotation read from VV and VH. Scatter: water or Ludox; the prompt is the IRF after the floor (and a buffer). Non-burst (the photons outside the bursts): a Gaussian fitted to the scatter prompt's rising edge, leaving the fluorescent tail behind. Burst MLE takes its IRF from the same extraction.
Every setting of the extraction (Advanced).

sections.label: Time/Channel (ns)
sections.description: Time per channel in nanoseconds, set from the data. Correct it when the file carries none: the time axis, lifetime and rate are rescaled, the IRF per channel is unchanged.

sections.label: VV | VH halves
sections.description: The data holds two halves, VV then VH, each extracted on its own; a reference dye's rotation is read from them. Off: one curve (deconvolved with the plain exponential).

sections.label: Lifetime (ns)
sections.description: The reference dye's lifetime. 0: fitted to the tail of VV + 2 VH (the listed lifetime when that fails or is more than a factor two off).

sections.label: Listed (ns)
sections.description: The dye's lifetime as listed (reference_dyes.yaml: Rh110 4.0 ns, Alexa647 1.0 ns): the check on the fitted one.

sections.label: ρ (ns)
sections.description: The dye's rotational correlation time. 0: read from the data (the time at which the IRFs of VV and VH have one shape). Needs VV | VH halves.

sections.label: IRF model
sections.description: The pulse fitted to the prompt of the photons outside the bursts. Gaussian or Skewed Gaussian leave the fluorescent tail behind; Measured keeps the floor-free prompt as measured.

sections.label: Shift VV (bins)
sections.description: The IRF's time shift in VV against the reference dye, as Burst MLE calibrated it (the dye's decay fitted with the IRF, its lifetime fixed). Changed here, it goes back with the IRF and replaces the calibrated one.

sections.label: Shift VH (bins)
sections.description: The IRF's time shift in VH against the reference dye, as Burst MLE calibrated it. Changed here, it goes back with the IRF.

sections.label: SG Window Length
sections.description: Savitzky-Golay filter window length (channels) used to find the decay maximum; the estimator makes it odd.

sections.label: SG Poly Order
sections.description: Polynomial order of the Savitzky-Golay filter.

sections.label: RL Iterations
sections.description: Richardson-Lucy deconvolution iterations. More iterations sharpen the IRF and amplify noise: where you stop is the regularisation. Auto-update uses 50.

sections.label: Regularization
sections.description: Median filter size for regularization (1 = no regularization).

sections.label: Manual Background
sections.description: Background counts per channel subtracted before the estimate (0 = auto-estimate). Loading a file sets it to the median of the last 10 % of channels.
Range selection and automatic re-estimation.

sections.label: 📍  Use Range Selection
sections.description: Use only a channel range for the estimate: drag the green region in the plot or type its first and last channel.

sections.label: 🔄  Auto-Update IRF
sections.description: Re-estimate the IRF (50 RL iterations) when a parameter, the background or the range changes, once an IRF exists.
The estimation range in channels.

sections.label: First channel
sections.description: First channel of the estimation range (inclusive).

sections.label: Last channel
sections.description: Last channel of the estimation range (inclusive).

buttons.description: Fit the decay tail with a truncated exponential, then deconvolve it with Richardson-Lucy to obtain the IRF.
